definitions.explanation: A pleasant, sweet smell. A literary and somewhat formal word for fragrance, often used for flowers, herbs, teas, and perfumes.

examples.japanese: バラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{芳香|ほうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}っている→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: The fragrance of roses is drifting in the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラベンダー→ラベンダー：30768_rabendaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{芳香|ほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リラックス→リラックス：02531_rirakkusu⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The fragrance of lavender has a relaxing effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶葉|ちゃば}→茶葉：15508_chaba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、{芳香|ほうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧いっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The moment the tea leaves were steeped, a sweet aroma filled the room.

notes:
USAGE:
{芳香|ほうこう} is more literary and elegant than ⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ (the everyday word for fragrance/scent) or ⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧ (smell, which can be positive or negative). Use {芳香|ほうこう} when describing pleasant aromas in writing or formal speech.

The compound {芳香|ほうこう}{剤|ざい} (air freshener, fragrance product) is common in everyday life.

Note the many homophones: ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧ (direction), ⟦{咆哮|ほうこう}→咆哮：11857_houkou⟧ (roar), ⟦{奉公|ほうこう}→奉公：12263_houkou⟧ (service). Context makes the meaning clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芳香|ほうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}う→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧: fragrance drifts/wafts
- {芳香|ほうこう}{剤|ざい}: air freshener
- {芳香|ほうこう}{族|ぞく}: aromatic (chemistry)
- {芳香|ほうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}つ→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧: to give off a fragrance
